review_notes.evidence: AX clearly prints E-E3M6; root independent native review agrees. Native continuation connector rows print 02R-B2 prefixes; all are retained despite A1 disagreements. AC unit is literally U03AC and its sole physical output B05 feeds the native R termination through a printed diamond.

The title prints PFR. Comparison with native FRAME F and independent root source review confirms F, with upper/central bars and no lower foot. Coordinator corrected the meaningful TIFF filename from PER to literal PFR, with unchanged scan SHA256 and original scan order; the exact filename correction audit is recorded.

All 21 native blocks, every field and every physical pin, all input data names/ref rows and four complete upper/lower fanout control rails, eight control diamonds and AC physical-output diamond, sixteen internal AND/OR paths, two unusually long input loop routes to AJ and AN that cross separate output rails, all four outputs, R termination, table/revision/title/footer inspected. Printed R-board prefixes and E-E3M6 are preserved as source literals; one unreadable cell has exact notes and original scan neighbors.
